modules.responsibility: Pure function to calculate total price in cents from rows
Async fetcher returning mock product catalog data
Reactive composable managing products/loading/error state with latest-wins concurrency
Presentational component rendering products list, loading, and error states via props/emits
Root view composing useCatalog state into CatalogList, handling retry orchestration
Vue app entry point mounting App to DOM

interfaces.errors: Error if rows not array, priceCents negative/non-integer, or quantity non-positive/non-integer

interfaces.outputs: { products: Ref<Array>, loading: Ref<boolean>, error: Ref<string>, load: () => Promise<void> }
interfaces.errors: Errors captured in error ref as string, never thrown outward

interfaces.inputs: props: { products: Array, loading: boolean, error: string }

patterns.name: Dependency Injection
patterns.reason: useCatalog accepts fetcher parameter enabling test doubles and decoupling from concrete API implementation

patterns.name: Composition API
patterns.reason: useCatalog encapsulates reactive state and behavior as a reusable composable, keeping App.vue thin and separating concerns.

patterns.name: Props/Emits
patterns.reason: CatalogList is a pure presentational component communicating only through props and events, ensuring view layer has no service dependencies.

patterns.name: Concurrency Guard (callId)
patterns.reason: Prevents race conditions when multiple load() calls overlap; only the latest invocation updates reactive state.

patterns.name: Latest-Wins Concurrency
patterns.reason: callId counter ensures stale async responses are discarded when newer load() calls are made

patterns.name: Props/Emits Communication
patterns.reason: CatalogList receives state via props and signals user actions via emits, keeping view layer decoupled from services/domain per design contract

patterns.name: Error Normalization
patterns.reason: error ref standardized to empty string for no-error states and nonempty string for failures, providing consistent truthy/falsy semantics for template conditionals
